description: Rothco’s Spandoflage Head Net offers an effective and convenient way to conceal your face while providing ultimate comfort and flexibility. Made in the USA with a durable 50% polyester and 50% cotton blend, this camo headnet is designed to be shrink and fade resistant, ensuring long-lasting use. The material’s unique properties allow it to conform to any shape, eliminating the need for messy face paint and providing a customized fit. Unlike other headnets, Rothco’s Spandoflage Head Net features non-precut eye holes, allowing you to cut them to your preferred size and shape for optimal vision and comfort. The ravel-proof material ensures that cutting the netting in any direction will not compromise its integrity. Perfect for various outdoor activities and scenarios where discretion is key, this headnet is versatile and reliable. 1 size fits most, making it a practical addition to your outdoor gear collection.
